description: Full project overview in one call: project, epics with task counts, stats, blocked and overdue tasks, recent activity and notes. Best first call when starting work. branch="current" scopes to the active git branch.

branch.description: Scope to a git branch: "current" = active branch, "" = branch-agnostic only, omit = all.

include_archived.description: Include archived epics and their tasks.

project_id.description: Project ID. Omit for a single-project database or when SAGA_PROJECT is set. Otherwise the first is used and the rest listed under other_projects.

name: tracker_dashboard
